business_problem: Nexi needed a single way to understand, allocate, and forecast cloud costs across Azure, AWS, Oracle Cloud, and Google Cloud because each team was working in provider-specific silos and there was no dependable basis for chargeback, accountability, or optimization.
solution_summary: Nexi implemented IBM Cloudability as the core of a centralized FinOps operating model spanning four cloud providers and more than EUR 20 million in annual spend. Cloudability aggregates cost data across Azure, AWS, Oracle Cloud, and Google Cloud, then maps that spend to business applications, legal entities, teams, departments, and services so different stakeholders can work from the same financial view. Nexi’s FinOps lead used Cloudability’s business-mapping features to create a structured tagging taxonomy, close allocation gaps, and automate chargeback to more than ten legal entities, while finance, engineering, business, and executive users each received tailored dashboards. The same platform improved forecasting accuracy, surfaced optimization levers such as rightsizing and off-hours shutdown, and made chargeback/showback processes practical for non-technical users. Instead of asking IT to answer cost questions manually, teams can now monitor their own consumption and act on a cross-cloud basis, turning cost visibility into an ongoing governance process.

solution_components.name: IBM Cloudability
solution_components.role: Centralizes multi-cloud cost visibility, forecasting, optimization, business mapping, and chargeback for Nexi’s FinOps program.

data_flow: Cost data from Azure, AWS, Oracle Cloud, and Google Cloud is consolidated in Cloudability, mapped to business applications and legal owners through tagging and business mappings, and then surfaced in role-specific dashboards for finance, engineering, business units, and executives to drive optimization and chargeback.
business_outcome: Within months, Nexi reduced cloud spend, improved forecast accuracy, raised tagging coverage, established real chargeback, and spread FinOps from a central function to dozens of teams across the business.
